dedupe_keys.name: roadsens 4m a multimodal smartphone camera dataset for holistic road way analysis

description: RoadSens-4M: A Multimodal Smartphone & Camera Dataset for Holistic Road-way Analysis is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Amith Khandakar et al. It’s important to monitor road issues such as bumps and potholes to enhance safety and improve road conditions. Smartphones are equipped with various built-in sensors that offer a cost-effective and straightforward way to assess road quality. However, progress in this area has been slow due to the lack of high-quality, standardized datasets. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 297354244 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
